newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mixed, light ends on defence.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mixed, light ends on defence.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mixed on Tuesday with light end prices on the defensive, traders said.
Gasoline ended steady, buoyed by a rebound in futures prices and anchored down by a closed arbitrage to the States.
Naphtha ended steady to slightly lower. Tighter supply was tempered by weaker gasoline, which cuts into reformer demand for heavier naphthenic and aromatic material, traders said.
Gas oil prices were easier as weaker barge and cargo premiums countered small gains on benchmark gas oil futures.
Traders said a $10-$13 arbitrage window was drawing additional supplies from the Mediterranean and putting pressure on cargo prices in a market already suffering from thin demand.
High sulphur fuel oil barges rose $1 to trade at $87 a tonne fob Rotterdam with tight supply and some buying interest helping the market despite some players' scepticism of the higher figures.
The high sulphur cargo market was quiet with sellers asking a few dollars over Monday's deal at $81.75 a tonne fob Coryton. One percent was said to be weaker but little buying interest.
